benchmark_type: Empirical Latency Hierarchy (Request-Level vs. Task Trajectory vs. Local AST)

request_level_model_latency_ms.description: Round-trip network + model inference latency for single API call (N=556 empirical traces)

task_level_trajectory_turnaround_ms.description: Cumulative model turnaround across multi-attempt task trajectory (convoluted sum over k attempts)
task_level_trajectory_turnaround_ms.methodology: Empirical bootstrap convolution (10,000 iterations summing k independent request samples)

local_ast_recomposition_latency_ms.description: Deterministic schema slicing and in-tree AST merging (local CPU execution)

scientific_conclusions.takeaway: Request-level model turnaround has p50 = 3407.1 ms. Complete task-level trajectory turnaround (summing over empirical attempt distribution) has p50 = 9594.1 ms. Local in-tree AST recomposition adds 0.0201 ms per round (~0.0402 ms per task), accounting for 0.00042% of complete task latency.
